senses.sense_definition: A person who gains sexual pleasure from watching others in private or intimate situations.

examples.text: The police arrested the <w>voyeur</w> for secretly filming people in their private homes.
He was labeled a <w>voyeur</w> after he was caught watching his neighbors through their bedroom window.

senses.sense_definition: A person who obsessively watches or follows scandalous or unpleasant events.

examples.text: The tabloid press acts as a <w>voyeur</w> into the private lives of celebrities.
Many people are <w>voyeur</w> figures who enjoy reading about the tragic lives of others.
